name: Sakakibara Yuri
source:
A lesbian. She's [url=https://vndb.org/c7777]Erika's[/url] domestic partner and lover. Because Seiichiro's genes are so regressive she hopes to use his sperm to become pregnant so it can be a baby she and her lover can share.

[spoiler]She doesn't mind sex with Seiichiro because he's so feminine and cute. She asks him to become a regular sexual partner of herself and Erika and even proposes marriage so they can have a legitimate family together.[/spoiler]

Her 'favorite number' is 18
